data.description:
This covers the third arc, Yorknew City. Looking for additional help with TS if anyone wants these to be released faster.

[Arc 1: Hunter Exam](https://nyaa.si/view/1731757)
[Arc 2: Heavens Arena](https://nyaa.si/view/1829502)

ITBD encode with modified Coalgirls subtitles. General cleanup of the dialogue (line breaks/splits/joins/timing). Undimmed or replaced various dimmed scenes. NCs are encoded using the USBD, matrix corrected, as the ITBD did not contain them. The NCOP had bad audio on the USBD, so replaced that with splices from regular eps. USBD English dub spliced together to match ITBD video.

[Comparison](https://slow.pics/c/jcP3iNYB)

**Staff List**
Timing: sam
Typesetting: P9
Song Styling: Nyarthur
Encoding: sam
